name: Cymbal Aerospace Marketing
brief: Lets focus on User interface and experience, the UI has lot of information and users will be overwhelmed. We need to make it simple

iterations.title: Iteration #1: Initial Build
iterations.brief: Marketing and video generation studio powered by Gemini models like omni, nano banana etc. It brings creative briefing, storyboarding, image generation, motion video synthesis, voiceover/music scoring, and automated brand evaluation into a single studio interface.

phases.title: Brief & Setup
phases.notes: Synthesized research.md across 4 cloned Google GenMedia repos (genmedia-creative-studio, dreamboard, storycraft, vigenair), 6 internal Ad Marketing Skills, and live Vertex AI ADC (vertex-ai-demos-468803) endpoint verification.

items.label: Write problem brief (client-brief.md)
Initialize project workspace (AGENTS.md, issues/, ralph/)
Verify Cloud authentication & API keys (.env)
Document codebase & domain context in research.md (optional)
Explore UI direction with quick prototypes (optional)

phases.title: Design Discovery
phases.notes: Aligned on 6-stage Guided Studio Pipeline + Non-Linear Scene Canvas, Full-Stack TypeScript (@google/genai >=2.29.1 + Express/Fastify + SQLite/JSON + FFmpeg), Nano Banana 2.1 reference fusion + Omni 1.1 Flash keyframe-locked motion with stateful previous_interaction_id editing, Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS Voice Design + keyframe-conditioned Lyria 3.5 scoring with -12dB ducking, Multimodal Structured Brand Eval with 1-click auto-fix, and pre-seeded Cymbal Aerospace Brand Kit with non-destructive stale cascades.

items.label: Run interactive design Q&A (/grill-me) on the brief
Resolve core user flows & architecture choices
Define auth, data model & error-handling edge cases
Lock in final design direction

phases.title: Technical Spec (PRD)
phases.notes: Generated issues/prd.md with 5 Deep Modules (CampaignVault, GeminiStudioGateway, StudioPipelineOrchestrator, MasterTimelineAssembler, StudioWorkspaceUI), behavioral testing boundaries, and negative Out of Scope constraints.

items.label: Define core modules & public interfaces (/plan)
Specify integration test boundaries & required credentials
Document explicit non-goals & out-of-scope items
Write technical spec (issues/prd.md)

phases.title: Task Breakdown
phases.notes: Sliced issues/prd.md into 7 end-to-end vertical tracer-bullet tickets (issues/001-*.md through issues/007-*.md) with explicit Blocked-by DAG dependencies and AFK/HITL classifications.

items.label: Break issues/prd.md into end-to-end feature slices
Verify Task #1 delivers a working end-to-end slice (schema + API + UI + test)
Tag each task as Autonomous (AFK) or Guided (HITL)
Map task dependencies (Blocked by)
Save task files to issues/

phases.title: Test-Driven Build (TDD)
phases.notes: Completed all 7 vertical tracer-bullet slices (001 through 007) via Vertical TDD across 5 Deep Modules (CampaignVault, GeminiStudioGateway, StudioPipelineOrchestrator, MasterTimelineAssembler, StudioWorkspaceUI). All 7 Vitest test suites (9 behavioral tests), TypeScript typecheck, and Vite production build pass with 0 errors; tickets moved to issues/done/.

items.label: Run first task with Red-Green-Refactor TDD (/tdd)
Verify behavioral tests pass against real interfaces (no production mock fallbacks)
Pass full test suite & typecheck
Commit changes & move completed task to issues/done/
Complete all unblocked tasks (/goal or /teamwork)

phases.title: Code Review & Browser QA
phases.notes: Completed fresh-context automated code review and live 6-stage browser QA on http://127.0.0.1:4190. Resolved all findings via vertical ticket 008-phase6-review-and-qa-hardening.md and archived issues/prd.md to issues/done/prd.md.

items.label: Run automated code & security review against issues/prd.md
Test live user flows end-to-end in the browser (/browser)
Log any QA bugs as follow-up tasks in issues/
Archive completed issues/prd.md to issues/done/

phases.title: Architecture & Learnings
phases.notes: Completed Ousterhout deep-module audit, adopted Design 3 (Caller-Optimized Stage Facade) for StudioPipelineOrchestrator in 009-refactor-deep-pipeline-orchestrator.md, and persisted architectural conventions in AGENTS.md.

Evaluate simpler module interface alternatives

Enable required Cloud APIs & configure secrets
Deploy app or agent to Cloud Run / Vertex AI / Firebase

phases.notes: Aligned on Option A (4-Step Storycraft Pill Flow: 1. Brief, 2. Storyboard & Visuals, 3. Voice & Soundtrack, 4. Final Cut).
